warm white surface and terracotta primary

warm white surface and terracotta primary

pages.title: 发布

continuityAnchors: mobile top bar only (bottom nav hidden for task)
warm white surface and terracotta primary

pages.title: 论坛

continuityAnchors: mobile top bar + bottom tab shell
warm white surface and terracotta primary
